mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(w.start_at, #{from}), LEAST(w.end_at, #{to}))) * w.configured_capacity), 0) FROM schedule_availability_window w WHERE w.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND w.store_id = #{storeId} AND w.status = 'OPEN' AND w.start_at < #{to} AND w.end_at > #{from}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(r.start_at, #{from}), LEAST(r.end_at, #{to})))), 0) FROM schedule_reservation r WHERE r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.start_at < #{to} AND r.end_at > #{from}
